question: What address does the vLLM OpenAI-compatible server listen on by default?
reference_answer: It starts at http://localhost:8000; change it with --host and --port.
author: smoke-test

question: How do I turn on automatic prefix caching?
reference_answer: Set enable_prefix_caching=True in the vLLM engine.
author: smoke-test

question: My model does not fit on one GPU. How can I spread it across several GPUs on the same machine?
reference_answer: Use tensor parallelism by setting tensor_parallel_size to the number of GPUs.
author: smoke-test

question: On the CPU backend how do I control the size of the KV cache?
reference_answer: Set the VLLM_CPU_KVCACHE_SPACE environment variable (default 4 GiB).
author: smoke-test

question: What do I need to install before serving a GGUF model?
reference_answer: The vllm-gguf-plugin package; GGUF support moved to an out-of-tree plugin.
author: smoke-test

question: How much does a vLLM enterprise license cost per month?
reference_answer: Not in the documentation; the system should refuse.
author: smoke-test
